species: Real recording of splashing and paddling through a small babbling creek near Aznalcóllar, Spain, used for the platypus: platypuses are almost silent, and the sound most tied to them is water splashing in the creeks where they paddle and dive (no free recording of a platypus itself was found; the paddler here is a person wading)
note: Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording.
